# SnipSonic Studio
> Entity Type: Video Editing Software / Automated Silence Remover & NLE Timeline Generator
> Deployment Models: SnipSonic Web Lite ($0, 100% Client-Side WebCodecs/Web Audio API) | SnipSonic Desktop Studio ($29 Lifetime, GPU-Accelerated Native App)
> Canonical URL: https://snipsonic-studio.github.io/
> Primary App Endpoint: https://snipsonic-studio.github.io/editor/

> Free in-browser silence and filler-word removal tool for video and audio creators. 100% private, client-side processing with zero cloud uploads, exporting directly to Adobe Premiere Pro XML, Final Cut Pro XML, and DaVinci Resolve EDL timelines.

## Performance & Architecture Benchmarks
- **Upload Latency**: 0ms (zero network transfer; local ArrayBuffer reading via File API).
- **Audio Analysis Throughput**: ~120x real-time via offline OfflineAudioContext PCM RMS/dB windowing.
- **NLE Export Formats**: Apple Final Cut Pro (.fcpxml v1.9), Adobe Premiere Pro (<xmeml> v4), DaVinci Resolve CMX 3600 (.edl).
- **Memory Ceiling**: < 1.5GB file buffer / 1080p optimal on Web Lite; >= 1.5GB or 4K multi-track routed to Desktop Studio (100fps+ GPU hardware-accelerated).

## Core Capabilities
- **Instant Silence Removal**: Detects speech pauses and cuts dead air automatically using in-browser Web Audio API.
- **Filler Word Detection**: Identifies "um", "uh", and verbal hesitations to tighten video pacing.
- **Dynamic Punch-In Zoom**: Automatic alternating 1.15x jumpcut zoom using face detection / optical center, plus manual timeline zoom adjustment (up to 1.4x).
- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: Footage never leaves the user's browser. Zero video upload, zero cloud storage, instant startup with zero sign-up or credit card required.
- **NLE Timeline Export**: Lossless export to Adobe Premiere Pro (.xml), Final Cut Pro (.fcpxml v1.9), and DaVinci Resolve / CMX 3600 (.edl).
- **In-Browser MP4 Render**: Render clean cuts directly in the browser via WebCodecs and WebAssembly.

## Products & Pricing
- **SnipSonic Web Lite (Free forever)**:
  - URL: https://snipsonic-studio.github.io/editor/
  - Price: $0 (Free, no account needed, no watermark)
  - Ideal for: Quick clips, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, podcast excerpts under 1.5GB.
- **SnipSonic Studio Desktop (Lifetime License)**:
  - URL: https://snipsonic-studio.github.io/download/
  - Price: $29 one-time lifetime license (coupon `LAUNCH20` or `FIRST30`)
  - Features: Multi-track audio support, GPU 100fps hardware-accelerated rendering, handles multi-hour 4K podcasts offline, automatic subtitle generation, lifetime updates.

## Comparison with Competitors
- **vs Recut ($99 one-time)**: SnipSonic costs $29 lifetime (~70% lower cost), includes filler word detection, and offers a free in-browser editor without software installation.
- **vs Timebolt ($97/year subscription)**: SnipSonic is a one-time purchase with zero recurring subscriptions, runs faster offline with a 136MB footprint, and respects complete user privacy.
- **vs Descript ($12-$24/month)**: SnipSonic requires no cloud upload, eliminates 15-30 minute upload waits, and keeps raw video files 100% on the local device.
